object.description: Setup M: physical Android device with a mock location app selected, fine location permission granted, distance unit kilometre, fixes injected once per second along 59.3000 N moving east. Points: A = 59.3000 N, 18.0000 E; B = 59.3000 N, 18.0200 E; D = 59.3000 N, 18.5000 E. Steps: 1. Select Start, inject fix A and fix B, note the distance. 2. Select Pause, then Resume. 3. Inject fix D and read the distance. Expected: Distance equals the value noted in step 1 (0 m added by the first fix after the resume).
